epistemic_status: NO novelty verified for any kept idea. All prior-art-risk statements are this judge's unverified hypotheses. No citations invented; three generator-side references to real named works (Geirhos, Darcet, Goh) were checked for tone, flagged as convention risk, not fabrication.
method: Pass 1 field audit: all 302 ideas checked for the 12 required fields (community_default_belief, why_it_might_be_wrong, fastest_falsification_experiment included); scan for fabricated citations and unhedged novelty claims.

Pass 2 template extraction: meta-templates identified per shard and cross-shard (SAM+X, LoRA+X, loss+X, cue-ablation, hidden-variance, shortcut-solvable, reweighting, scale-null, convention-decodability, etc.); each family consolidated to paradigm primaries.
Pass 3 falsifiability and tone attack: existence-claims, protocol-proposals-dressed-as-hypotheses, strawman community beliefs, and known-critique restatements flagged or killed.
Pass 4 anomaly protection: unusual, contrarian, non-template ideas explicitly protected against consolidation pressure.

Kill/merge is hypothesis-level: two ideas merge only when they assert the same mechanism testable by one experimental design; substrate permutations (domain, metric, technique slot) do not count as distinct hypotheses.

kill_reasons.W13-P1-A-077: No held community belief is attacked: nobody claims text conditioning costs nothing in robustness. Immunity of a coordinate-only interface to typographic binding follows from the interface definition; quantifying an expected asymmetry is a measurement, not a hypothesis. SAM+X security permutation.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-A-085: Early-exit / dynamic-depth is a mature efficiency literature ported to SAM. No belief challenged; the mechanism ('easy inputs saturate early') is the premise of that literature, not a finding. Unverified prior-art risk: very high.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-A-089: Curriculum/ordering is a generic continual-learning permutation (orders x domains). Mechanism stated at metaphor level ('breaks structures'); falsification requires a combinatorial sweep of sequential adaptations. High cost, low distinctiveness.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-C-016: Restates the long-standing critique that OOD benchmarks fall to trivial low-level statistics; hedged in tone but adds no new mechanism or protocol beyond re-running known baselines. Unverified prior-art risk: very high.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-C-036: Strawman community belief: the field demonstrably does not hold that region overlap suffices; boundary-quality metrics are standard practice. The contrarian frame is manufactured; what remains is a correlation audit.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-C-055: Attention-vs-explanation faithfulness is a famous, extensively litigated debate. The idea restates it for vision transformers without a new falsifiable twist.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-C-062: Non-transfer of adversarial robustness across threat models is a well-documented negative result. The proposed cross-threat matrix is a replication catalog, not a new claim.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-C-059: The metric-artifact account of emergent abilities is a widely known position; porting it to visual tasks changes neither the hypothesis nor the test.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-C-104: Adaptive human-in-the-loop stress-testing is established practice, and 'static sets miss failures humans can find' is not a contested belief. Nothing distinct left to falsify.

anomaly_notes.W13-P1-A-031: Contrarian against 'segmentation foundation model = general visual foundation model'; boundary/semantic anti-correlation across layers is a checkable dissociation.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-A-044: Representational blind spot (relationally defined regions unreachable by prompt-as-locator) that no PEFT fixes; attacks the interface, not the weights.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-A-063: Guideline archaeology: foundation models memorize annotation policy, not just imagery. Opens a data-provenance forensics line.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-A-065: SA-1B grid-prompt fingerprint inside SAM's prior: dataset-construction artifact detectable in the model. Unusual and cheap to test.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-A-066: mIoU anti-correlates with interactive usability across PEFT methods: directly attacks the field's selection criterion.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-A-079: Modal/amodal instability governed by prompt geometry: names an unacknowledged output-semantics ambiguity with a lawful structure claim.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-A-087: Catastrophic remembering: adaptation moves a model backward along its own training history. Genuinely new framing of forgetting.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-016: Human-model gap on glass may be an evaluation-regime artifact near an information ceiling; deflates an entire benchmark-progress narrative.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-022: Ambiguity and difficulty are different, possibly anti-correlated pixel populations; most uncertainty work conflates them.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-029: Scaling asymptote as ontology failure, not data shortage: pretraining scale cannot buy what the label space cannot express.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-030: Mass-noun linguistic penalty in text-prompted segmentation: a language-side cause for vision-side failure. Cross-modal and cheap.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-054: Representation-ambiguity matching law (soft maps vs mask sets, double dissociation): would organize the uncertainty-representation literature.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-060: Information gap vs model gap: a small polarimetric probe beating RGB foundation models would redirect effort from scale to sensing.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-069: Predict the spread-rate derivative, not the state: re-poses the task around what is annotator-stable and decision-relevant.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-071: Event-camera combustion microdynamics separating real flames from depictions: hardware-level contrarian, crisp signature claim.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-083: Sparse physical sensor labels beating dense human labels per dollar: attacks the annotation-centric worldview with a costed prediction.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-090: Ambiguity-type transfer beats domain-appearance transfer: a transfer-matrix design with a genuinely surprising off-diagonal prediction.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-B-093: Human-model failure complementarity largest on hard domains: quantifies where teams (not models) have headroom.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-C-032: Adaptive overfitting returning in the foundation era would reverse the celebrated replication-era conclusion; release-date-dependent gap is testable.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-C-069: Model-assisted annotation self-preference loops: ground truth itself is becoming model-lineage-biased. Ecosystem-level contamination claim.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-C-072: Annotation-vendor convention leakage invisible to dedup: a leakage channel nobody audits, with a concrete fingerprinting test.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-C-074: Leaderboard winner's curse quantified from submission statistics: turns a folk suspicion into an estimable bias.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-C-075: Benchmark ecosystem low effective dimensionality: if one factor explains most rankings, new benchmarks add events, not information.

deliberate_tensions_kept.note: Head vs features: A-014 predicts the shifted-domain gap lives in the readout; B-031 predicts hard-domain gaps live in the features. Designed head-to-head; both kept (with C-048 as the confound-control arm).
Threshold pathology, opposite valence: A-076 says thresholds hide recoverable competence; B-033 says thresholds manufacture fake competence differences. Complementary; both kept.
Prompt jitter as pathology (over-adaptation early warning) vs as signal (ambiguity meter). Same measurement, opposite uses; both kept.
Shape-prior monoculture from model-in-the-loop data (A) vs from human blob priors (B): convergent claims with different causal sources; both kept to let the data decide.

caveats: kill_or_merge is not a quality verdict; merge targets say where content folds. The Consolidator may resurrect any merged id.
This judge is deliberately harsher on permutation families than on risky single ideas; a protected anomaly with a thin experiment beats a polished template instance.
Prior-art risk labels are unverified hypotheses; the prior_art_risk_high watchlist should be first in line for the search gate.

Cross-shard convergence (three 'independent' generators, same idea) should be read by the Consolidator as a prior-art warning signal: attractors of the generating model are likely near the field's public discourse.
Judge B output was not available; consolidation should not treat this file as incorporating feasibility triage.
